stable.label: matter-lab-0.3-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.3 remains the integrated baseline. 0.4 is isolated on a candidate branch until full PR CI passes. Live GitHub.io and real iPhone Safari remain separately unverified.

added_capabilities: explicit forward and reverse toy reaction events
internal transformed state on reacted associated particles
reaction event history with pair, species, step and reduced time
particle-count conservation invariant across state transformations
reacted associations alter the coarse-grained pair interaction

active_objective: Independently test Matter Lab 0.4 reaction-event bookkeeping, transformed state, conservation invariants and reversible event path in GitHub Actions.
next_gate: Open PR from genesis-matter-0.4 to main, inspect the actual simulation test and entire workflow, repair any failure, and merge only on full PASS.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Toy reaction events must not be described as validated chemistry
Particle state transformation must conserve particle count
